scope: Metadata only: request-log fields, Claude Code session counts and SDK transcript send counts. No prompts, outputs, tool results or credentials.
symptom: A Claude Code session on claude-opus-5-5-max[1m] repeatedly showed 'API Error: Server error mid-response'.

calibration.note: Completed text-only request on the same instance near the failures.

claude_1m_over_1900000_bytes.note: Completions were mostly tool-result continuations of paused runs; every failure sent the full prompt cold.

diagnosis: At about 990k SDK tokens each cold run overflowed the 1M window after the roughly 81k-character tool-schema lookup, re-sent the prompt 4-6 times and hit the 1800 s deadline. Native tool-use responses report zero usage and the 3 MiB guard never fired, so Claude Code never compacted.

change.codex_instance: unchanged global 3 MiB; its history has more bytes per token
change.rejected_continuation: cancels the paused run it would have resumed
change.restart: refusals list inference, tool waits and queued requests; --force drops them

acceptance.note: The resumed turn got a 400; Claude Code retried with shorter histories until its compaction request fit under 1,900,000 bytes.
